deadline_semantics: Original per-profile acquisition stop boundary persists across stages and resume. Inflight bounded native work reaches safe cleanup; any overrun is retained, never excluded from project time. Setup/build and CI queues remain counted in the project ledger.

resource_contract.envelope: max sampled large-file controller RSS across all accepted formal+independent cycles minus min sampled small-file controller RSS; no division by repetition count
resource_contract.required_stability: controller sampled RSS range for each registered scenario <=8MiB across the four formal and two independent fresh-process cycles; operational repeatability screen, not a population confidence interval
resource_contract.target_scope: Source-audited streamed path, observed8MiB..128MiB range; sampled RSS, no instantaneous peak or universal asymptotic claim
resource_contract.native_engine: Report its independent RSS/CPU curve; no invented upstream efficiency threshold

latency.role: Descriptive absolute latency/CPU and operational variation, no baseline speedup or latency pass target

preparation.correctness: Four real workloads, complete bytes/state/normal tree exit
preparation.calibration: 1000 read-cost snapshots, monotonic clock,16MiB touched-memory units, CPU monotonicity,12 balanced short/long controls
preparation.pretrial: Two opposite complete orders,8 fresh controllers+engines,8/8 VALID in49.166s; observed max full case6.9003s
preparation.reuse_scope: N4 adds role/config/source validation and complete-group recording outside measurement. Rust workload, timing boundaries, sampling loop, metric reads and quality thresholds remain unchanged. Confirm updated collector dependencies before formal.
preparation.v2: Each actual CI profile completes two opposite full pretrial orders using exact frozen source inputs before formal acquisition; prep is not formal evidence.
preparation.v3: Repeat calibration and two opposite full actual pretrial orders on each actual profile; v2 pretrial and accepted groups are not v3 samples.
preparation.v4: New counter/timer calibration and8actualfresh pretrial cases per actual profile before complete new formal and independent acquisition.

retention: All attempts including insufficient/slow/error records retained. Only immutable complete original-order groups accepted. ERROR stops; insufficient retries original cycle without resetting deadline or counts.

revision.retained: All v1-v3 observations and failures retain original bytes, attempts, source identities and budgets; no old row is a v4 sample.
revision.changes: Atomic binary writes preserve exact frozen protocol bytes onWindows; canonical LF JSON records. Darwin observer self-threadQoS set only after worker ready; borrowed scheduling intervals do not change metric quality gates.
revision.cause: Windows outer9c3b.. vs nestedb97c.. from128CRLF substitutions; MacARM three attempts had66.158/94.935/107.706ms gaps with6/10timerexpirations and<0.3ms metric reads. Exact delay cause beyond observer interval unresolved.
revision.unchanged: Rust sources/artifacts, every input/repeat/workload, operation boundaries, all quality/memory/stability thresholds, four formal+two independent fresh-process cycles, attempt limits and original project/phase budgets.

observer_policy.darwin: Request QOS_CLASS_USER_INITIATED0x19 only on the short-lived observer thread after the real controller and engine are ready; retain requested/observed receipt. No worker or global priority changes.
observer_policy.scope: Measurement observer, not library runtime; no timing-quality relaxation or scheduling guarantee.
